findings.oracle: Real ChatPanel driven via qtbot mouseClick on the real Send button after typing whitespace-padded text; independent recorders capture both inner ChatInput.message_submitted and outer ChatPanel.message_submitted; asserts inner_emissions == panel_emissions == [('disassemble the entry point',)], exactly one emission, single str arg, input cleared, no bubble/no stored message, Send button stays enabled - corrupting the _input.message_submitted->self.message_submitted.emit relay or the strip/clear in _on_send turns it red.

Real ToolStatusDialog(tool_statuses=prefetched) with NO faked QThread.start; asserts _status_workers == [] (no worker spawned), all six rows rendered exactly row-by-row against independently built _EXPECTED_ROWS in canonical _tool_rows() order, each glyph cross-checked against the payload availability flag (checkmark/cross), display name and message present per row, currentRow()==0 - a scrambled order, blanked row, wrong glyph, or stray worker turns it red.
